n-spacex-share-gift.summary: Coins named for SpaceX after its pledge of shares to American children. Posts from about 20:30 UTC on 2026-11-25 say SpaceX will put one of its shares into every active Trump Account and that Elon Musk will match it. On 2026-11-26 at 03:43 UTC Musk posted "Every child in America will receive two SpaceX shares, one from the company and one from me personally"; Reuters reported that the pledge could be worth more than $18 billion, and Fox News that SpaceX pledges to donate stock to every active Trump Account with Musk matching it. Three coins are members: SpaceXCoin on Flap (BNB Chain, 0xdde274...), whose pool opened at 05:27 UTC on 2026-11-26, about two hours after Musk's post; SpaceXCoin on Pump.fun (G2XqmS...), opened at 02:24 UTC on 2026-11-27, whose description says "SpaceXCoin represents SpaceXLife" (SpaceXLife is an earlier BNB Chain coin that posts tie to Musk's post); and SpaceX on Clanker V4 (Base, 0x7d1a56...), opened at 05:27 UTC on 2026-11-27 with no description. Neither SpaceX nor Musk has issued a coin, and none of these coins is shown to be connected to them. The share gift is a pledge; its delivery is not verified here. Measured: three coins across all their pools. The Base coin opened after this run's 05:00 UTC chart anchor, so it adds no volume to today's window.
